# LANCOOL III

 

## LANCOOL III

- Mid-tower modular chassis for all kinds of configurations
- Equipped with 4 × 140 PWM fans (ARGB or non-RGB)
- Featured airflow optimized mesh structure and hinged side panels
- Supports up to 420 radiator or 3 x 360 radiators and a maximum of 10 fans
- Offers 12 storage drives mounting locations
- Upgraded cable management solution for a clean build

 

 

LANCOOL III, the premium mid-tower chassis, offers better thermal performance than LANCOOL II by including 4 pre-installed 140mm PWM fans, and featuring fine mesh panels designed to ensure ample airflow is delivered to the high-end components while the system runs at peak performance.

The LANCOOL III black features a premium hairline brushed aluminum element that looks as good as it feels, while the LANCOOL III white features a minimalist white powder coating. The tempered glass panel allows showing off the internal components.

The two bottom side panels provide sufficient airflow to efficiently cool the GPU when fans are installed above the PSU shroud

##### Front Panel

 

The 51% porosity offers an ample direct fresh air intake

The hinged tempered glass side panels offer an unobstructed view of the interior configuration, while the bottom shroud panels provide quick access to the PSU and storage drives.

...

## ASUS AP201

冰立方机箱

### 33升机箱

​ASUS AP201 冰立方机箱采用 microATX 机箱设计，支持 360mm 一体式冷排和支持长达 338 mm 的显卡，虽然尺寸小巧，拥有强大的兼容能力。AP201 机箱的侧板采用免工具拆卸和防跌落设计，其优雅的造型勾勒出十足的科技感。

### 出色的通风性能

AP201 冰立方采用网格式设计，AP201 机箱顶部，左侧、右侧和前侧的金属板使用了超过 57,000 个精密制造的 1.5mm 方形透气孔，使机箱在透气性和防尘性之间取得上佳的平衡。

### 保持酷凉

支持 280 和 360mm 冷排和多达 6 个风扇，AP201 冰立方轻松组建强大散热系统，确保硬件性能充分释放。

...

AP201 冰立方的底部配备两个 120mm 风扇安装位，包含一个可拆卸的防尘网，以提升系统散热性能。

### 桌面小钢炮

尽管体积小巧，AP201 却蕴含着强大的能力。支持 180mm 长的标准 ATX 电源，338mm 长的显卡、水冷系统，及广泛的存储设备。

...

### 整洁不凌乱

AP201 冰立方提供了一条 32mm 厚，65mm 宽的理线空间，轻松理线，配合侧面遮线盖，让机箱内部整洁美观。

...

除了具备两个 Type-A USB 3.2 Gen 1 接口外，AP201 冰立方的前面板还配备一个 USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C 接口。

...

### 选择您的风格

AP201 冰立方提供哑光黑和磨砂白可供选择，以前卫的造型彰显个性风格。

5.0 out of 5 stars Best quality ASUS product I've ever used

Reviewed in Canada on March 25, 2023

Size: SFF MeshColor: ‎AP201|Mesh|White Verified Purchase

I'm not a big fan of ASUS, used their laptop and GPU before but they lacked build quality and often overheat.This case however is a different story. The design is elegant, build quality feels premium with nice surface finish, also comes with clean and simple cable management and a decent case fan. Airflow is good despite not having room for front fan, I think the way they positioned PSU at the front actually makes a lot of sense.Another big plus is the subtle yet refined appearance. I'm not a fan of the fully exposed glass design of modern cases, and this offers a great option while still showing off some of the interior + lights.Overall extremely satisfied with the case. Personally will probably still stay away from their electronics, but will keep an eye out for more peripherals such as this.
